name: chief-of-staff
description: Your AI chief of staff. Sweeps email, calendar, chat and tasks every two hours and keeps a living Markdown registry in Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint or a local folder — with morning briefs, meeting prep and weekly reviews. Read-only on your sources; vendor-agnostic.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps you on top of email, calendar and chat
interface.longDescription: Chief of Staff watches your email, calendar, chat and tasks on a schedule and keeps a living Markdown registry in your own Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint or local folder: what needs you now, today's meetings with context, open loops, and notes on people and projects. It writes morning briefs, preps you for meetings and runs a weekly review. It only reads your sources — it never sends, replies to, archives or deletes anything.
defaultPrompt: Set up my chief of staff
Run radar: what did I miss?
